channel.title: DoW Opportunity Finder
channel.description: Department of War scholarships, fellowships, internships, workshops and faculty programs for HSRU students and faculty.

item.title: ONR Sabbatical Leave Program
item.description: Residential Navy laboratory research for one semester to one year. Student participation: no accompanying-student award is promised; discuss separate student internships and project coordination with the laboratory before planning a team visit. Timing: Submit the application at least six months before the proposed sabbatical; confirm intake availability with the program..

item.title: DEVCOM Army Research Laboratory Faculty Fellowship (RAP)
item.description: Faculty research appointments with Army Research Laboratory scientists; applications are accepted throughout the year. Student participation: ARL has a separate Summer Student Experience, but the faculty award does not guarantee student places or placement together. Timing: Faculty fellowship applications are accepted year-round; check individual projects for availability and any specific deadline..

item.title: HPCMP Faculty Immersion Experience (FIX)
item.description: Ten-week summer faculty research at DoW host organizations using high-performance computing. Students apply separately through the companion HPC Internship Program (HIP); a shared mentor or location must be confirmed. Next application cycle is not verified. Timing: The last verified faculty call closed March 13, 2025. No current 2026/2027 application window was verified as of September 30, 2026; monitor the sponsor..

item.title: Naval Engineering Education Consortium (NEEC) faculty-student research
item.description: University grants for faculty-led naval engineering research with undergraduate or graduate students and Navy collaborators. This is a team research grant, not a visiting fellowship; on-site student work requires host arrangements. FY2026 call remains forecasted. Timing: Forecasted, not open: formal notice and revised deadline are not posted. Do not use the old October 15, 2025 date printed in the pre-release attachment..

item.title: VICEROY Scholars — MAVEN and ENVOY Internships
item.description: Cybersecurity and electromagnetic spectrum training through VICEROY academic partners, with paid MAVEN and ENVOY summer internships at defense host sites. Includes research, mentoring and leadership development. Timing: No dated next-cycle deadline is posted on the official internship page; check the application link and program office for the current MAVEN/ENVOY window..

item.title: SCALE — Microelectronics Research and Career Pathways
item.description: Scalable Asymmetric Lifecycle Engagement (SCALE) connects students with semiconductor and microelectronics research, mentoring, internships and targeted scholarships. Topics include advanced packaging, radiation hardening, chip design and trusted AI. Timing: No single program-wide student deadline is posted. Use the student application page; scholarship, research and employer deadlines vary..

item.title: UC President’s Postdoctoral Fellowship — National Laboratories
item.description: UC-sponsored STEM postdoctoral research at Lawrence Berkeley, Lawrence Livermore or Los Alamos, with mentoring, professional development and networking. Apply through the central PPFP portal and identify a host-laboratory technical adviser. Deadline: November 1, 2026.

item.title: HPCMP High Performance Computing Internship Program (HIP)
item.description: Ten-week mentored research in high-performance computing at defense research organizations. Supports STEM students and recent graduates working on computational science and engineering. The 2026 call is closed; next-cycle dates are not announced. Timing: Next application cycle not announced. The 2026 call closed March 26, 2026 at 6 p.m. Eastern. Monitor the sponsor and Zintellect for the next call..

item.title: AFRL Repperger Research Intern Program
item.description: Mentored summer research in human performance, biomedical engineering, sensors, optics and related STEM fields at AFRL. The completed 2026 cycle included Wright-Patterson AFB and Fort Sam Houston; next-cycle projects and dates are not announced. Timing: Next application cycle not announced. The 2026 deadline was January 19, 2026; that internship ran June 1–August 7, 2026 and has ended..

item.title: Naval Health Research Center, San Diego (NREIP host)
item.description: Paid NREIP research in warfighter health, human performance, injury prevention, biomedical engineering and medical data science at Naval Base Point Loma. Select NHRC through the NREIP application. Deadline: November 30, 2026.

item.title: NSWC Port Hueneme Division (NREIP host)
item.description: Paid NREIP experience in ship combat systems, systems engineering, modeling and simulation, and test and evaluation. Select NSWC Port Hueneme through the NREIP application. Deadline: November 30, 2026.

item.title: Lockheed Martin defense internships
item.description: Student internships at a defense contractor. Choose a defense or national-security assignment and check its specific requirements. Timing: Program verified; availability and closing dates depend on individual vacancies..

item.title: BAE Systems U.S. LEAP internships and co-ops
item.description: U.S. LEAP placements in engineering, cyber, manufacturing and business at a defense contractor. Internships and co-ops are separate from graduate leadership jobs. Timing: Year-round program with a core summer season; recruitment commonly occurs in fall and spring. Each vacancy controls its deadline..

item.title: L3Harris defense internships
item.description: Student internships in defense technology, with mentoring and project experience across engineering and business functions. Apply to an individual U.S. vacancy. Timing: Program verified; availability and closing dates depend on individual vacancies..

item.title: General Dynamics Mission Systems internships
item.description: Paid summer experience on defense and security technologies at General Dynamics Mission Systems. Timing: Typically 10–12 weeks in summer. No common closing date verified; apply to current vacancies..

item.title: HII defense internships — shipbuilding and Mission Technologies
item.description: Paid placements at Ingalls Shipbuilding, Newport News Shipbuilding and Mission Technologies, supporting naval and other defense work. Timing: Corporate 2026 applications closed; check for 2027 announcements. Mission Technologies recruits throughout the year..

item.title: Booz Allen Summer Games — defense and national-security technology
item.description: Ten-week team internship developing technology prototypes for mission challenges, with mentors and a final presentation. Timing: Recruiting begins in late August and continues through fall for the following summer; closing dates vary..

item.title: CACI national-security internships and co-ops
item.description: Year-round student placements supporting national-security technology, software, engineering and related missions. Timing: Program verified; availability and closing dates depend on individual vacancies..

item.title: Peraton national-security internships and co-ops
item.description: Student work on national-security customer projects; summer internships and selected semester co-ops with mentoring. Timing: Typical recruiting: September–November and January–March; summer program generally ten weeks, June–August..

item.title: SNC aerospace and national-security internships
item.description: Engineering, cyber, manufacturing and business projects supporting aerospace, defense and national-security missions. Timing: Usually 10–12 weeks. Recruitment begins in fall, commonly August/September, for the next summer; vacancy dates control..

item.title: Textron Systems defense internships
item.description: Student placements at the defense-focused Textron Systems business. Search the student portal for current engineering and other vacancies. Timing: Page directs applicants to search 2027 Intern roles. Recommended application season: late August–February; vacancy deadlines control..

item.title: AeroVironment defense-technology internships
item.description: Paid projects in autonomy, robotics, software, hardware, manufacturing, space and cyber at a defense-technology employer. Timing: Program verified; availability and closing dates depend on individual vacancies..

item.title: Shield AI software engineering internship — summer 2027
item.description: On-site software work on autonomous defense systems, including applications, embedded software, machine learning and simulation. Timing: Summer 2027 posting available September 30, 2026; no deadline stated. Program text describes about 10–12 weeks..

item.title: Anduril engineering co-ops — winter 2027
item.description: Winter 2027 co-op vacancies in mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, systems, software and other engineering functions at a defense-technology company. Timing: Winter 2027 co-ops listed September 30, 2026. Filter to Internships; exact dates, pay and eligibility are vacancy-specific..

item.title: Boeing / Spirit Defense IT and cybersecurity internship — summer 2027
item.description: Paid internship supporting secure applications, cyber, infrastructure and data systems used by defense and space programs. Timing: Summer 2027 requisition 2026-17483, posted September 9, 2026; no closing date stated..

item.title: MIT Lincoln Laboratory Summer Research Program
item.description: Paid research on advanced technologies relevant to national security. This summer program accepts students from beyond MIT. Timing: Generally mid-May–mid-August; consult current student vacancies for the next cycle and deadlines..

item.title: Johns Hopkins APL national-defense research internships
item.description: Defense opportunities include 2027 shipboard systems, military cybersecurity and systems engineering internships. Select a defense assignment from the broader APL board. Timing: 2027 defense internships listed September 30, 2026; reviewed postings accept applications on a rolling basis..

item.title: MITRE National Security Intern Program
item.description: Mission-focused student pathway supporting defense and intelligence sponsors, with mentoring, technical learning and potential clearance sponsorship. Timing: Multi-year internship pathway; recruitment and work dates depend on current National Security vacancies..

item.title: Draper defense-research internships and co-ops
item.description: Undergraduate and graduate research placements. Choose a defense or national-security project; these are separate from the graduate Scholars award. Timing: Program verified; availability and closing dates depend on individual vacancies..

item.title: Draper Scholars graduate fellowship — awaiting next cycle
item.description: Graduate thesis research addressing national-security challenges with university and Draper co-advisers. The 2026 admissions cycle is closed. Timing: Closed. Last student deadline February 1, 2026; next-cycle dates unconfirmed..

item.title: SWE RTX Scholarship — awaiting next cycle
item.description: Engineering/computing scholarship sponsored by RTX, with preference for HBCU/HSI enrollment. The 2026–27 SWE application cycle is closed. Timing: 2026–27 closed; a 2027–28 interest form is available. Next application deadline unconfirmed..

item.title: SNC STEM Scholarship — awaiting next cycle
item.description: Scholarship and SNC mentor for nonmedical STEM students, funded through the Ozmen Foundation. Current applications are closed. Timing: Official status: closed. Reviewed page describes the 2026 cycle; future dates unconfirmed..

item.title: Shield AI Future Innovators Scholarship — awaiting next cycle
item.description: For graduating high-school seniors interested in AI, autonomy, aviation, robotics and related STEM. Applications closed April 15, 2026. Timing: Closed April 15, 2026; next-cycle announcement unconfirmed..

item.title: Army Educational Outreach Program internships and fellowships
item.description: Paid research internships for undergraduates and fellowships for graduate students and postdocs at Army labs and centers. Timing: Summer and year round; see current listings.

item.title: The Aerospace Corporation internships
item.description: Summer internships supporting national security space programs, in 14 or more disciplines from aerospace engineering to cybersecurity. Deadline: February 26, 2027.

item.title: Air Force Summer Faculty Fellowship Program (on hold)
item.description: AFOSR research residencies of 8-12 weeks include an explicit option for awarded faculty fellows to bring a graduate student. The application operator currently says the program is on hold indefinitely; this is a watchlist opportunity, not an open call. Timing: On hold indefinitely; confirmed on the application operator site September 30, 2026. The general AFRL page's annual August-October schedule does not establish an open call..

item.title: Air Force Young Investigator Program (FY2027)
item.description: Early career basic research grants; about 50 awards expected, $4.5 million total. Deadline: December 4, 2026.

item.title: AFRL Scholars at AFWERX
item.description: AFRL Scholars internships hosted by AFWERX, the Air Force innovation arm. Deadline: January 11, 2027.

item.title: AFRL Scholars at Catalyst Campus
item.description: AFRL Scholars internships at Catalyst Campus in Colorado. Deadline: January 11, 2027.

item.title: AFRL Scholars at Edwards AFB
item.description: AFRL Scholars summer internship at Edwards Air Force Base. Deadline: January 11, 2027.

item.title: AFRL Scholars at Eglin AFB
item.description: AFRL Scholars summer internship at Eglin Air Force Base. Deadline: January 11, 2027.

item.title: AFRL Scholars at Kirtland AFB
item.description: AFRL Scholars summer internship at Kirtland Air Force Base. Deadline: January 11, 2027.

item.title: AFRL Scholars at Rome Laboratory
item.description: AFRL Scholars summer internship at the Rome Laboratory in New York. Deadline: January 11, 2027.

item.title: AFRL Scholars Program
item.description: Paid summer research internships at Air Force Research Laboratory sites in 13 states and Washington, DC. Deadline: January 11, 2027.

item.title: DEVCOM ARL HBCU/MI Early Career Program
item.description: Basic research funding for early career faculty at HBCUs and Minority Serving Institutions. Timing: Last call closed January 12, 2024; watch for a new call.

item.title: DEVCOM ARL Postdoctoral Fellowship
item.description: Postdoctoral research appointments at the Army Research Laboratory; ORAU also runs journeyman, senior and faculty fellowships. Timing: Applications accepted year round.

item.title: ARL South summer students (Austin)
item.description: Army Research Laboratory's Austin site is one of three hosts for the Summer Student Experience. Timing: 2027 call not posted yet; the 2026 call closed February 25, 2026.

item.title: DEVCOM ARL Summer Student Experience
item.description: Summer research at the Army Research Laboratory for students from undergraduate through PhD, plus recent graduates. Timing: 2027 call not posted yet; the 2026 call closed February 25, 2026 for appointments from May to September.

item.title: Applied Research Laboratories student jobs and research assistantships
item.description: Paid part time and summer research jobs for undergraduates and graduate research assistantships at the Navy affiliated lab on the UT Austin campus. Timing: Positions posted year round on the UT Austin Workday portal.

item.title: Army HBCU/MI Research Teaming: graduate students
item.description: Army directory of about 15 programs for graduate students, including AEOP fellowships, SMART, NDSEG, the DoD HBCU/MI Summer Research Program and ORISE placements. Timing: Deadlines vary by program.

item.title: AscendR Opportunity Advising
item.description: HSRU initiative that strengthens how member campuses connect undergraduate and graduate students with DoW internships, fellowships and research experiences. Timing: Ongoing; questions to hsru@utep.edu.

item.title: AscendR Fellowship
item.description: One year cohort fellowship for STEM doctoral students doing defense aligned research with a faculty mentor. Deadline: January 31, 2027.

item.title: DoW Cyber Service Academy (CSA) Scholarship
item.description: Scholarship for cyber-related study at participating National Centers of Academic Excellence in Cybersecurity (NCAE-C), with paid summer internships and a post-graduation service commitment. Previously called the DoD Cyber Scholarship Program (CySP). Timing: Next recruitment deadline not verified; ask your participating campus CSA office for the next application window and any earlier campus deadline..

item.title: DARPA Young Faculty Award
item.description: Funding and mentoring for rising faculty stars in areas of interest to DARPA. Timing: Annual announcement is usually posted on Grants.gov and SAM.gov in September or October.

item.title: Defense Civilian Training Corps at the University of Arizona
item.description: Two year scholarship for juniors and seniors with DoW focused courses and summer internships; the University of Arizona is one of four pilot schools. Timing: Recruits rising juniors each year; contact the University of Arizona program office.

item.title: Army DEVCOM internships and academic programs
item.description: Army DEVCOM's list of student programs: AEOP apprenticeships and fellowships, SMART, the Defense Civilian Training Corps, CyberCorps, Pathways internships and NDSEG. Timing: Varies by program.

item.title: Defense University Research Instrumentation Program (DURIP, FY2027)
item.description: Equipment and instrumentation for university research of interest to the DoW. Deadline: November 6, 2026.

item.title: Construction Engineering Research Laboratory internships
item.description: Research internships at the Army Corps of Engineers laboratory for military facilities, energy and construction engineering. Timing: The 2026 posting stayed open until filled; watch Zintellect for 2027.

item.title: General Atomics summer internships
item.description: Ten week summer internships from June to August in engineering, science and business, including aeronautical and electromagnetic systems. Timing: Applications accepted September through the end of March; decisions by the end of March.

item.title: DoW HBCU/TCU Summer Research Internship Program
item.description: Summer research placements of about 11 weeks at DoW facilities for students and recent graduates of HBCUs, Tribal Colleges and Universities, and Minority Institutions. Timing: Summer 2027 dates not posted yet; the site offers email announcements for students.

item.title: Los Alamos National Laboratory student programs
item.description: Undergraduate and graduate student appointments at the national security lab in northern New Mexico. Timing: Apply through lanl.jobs; openings posted year round.

item.title: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory computing summer internships
item.description: Paid summer internships in computing at a national security laboratory near UC Davis, UC Merced and UC Santa Cruz; the lab also posts science and engineering internships. Deadline: January 15, 2027.

item.title: NAWCAD STEM Student Employment Program
item.description: Paid year round student employment at Navy aircraft engineering sites. Timing: Continuous applications.

item.title: NAWC Training Systems Division (NREIP host)
item.description: Navy center for training and simulation systems that hosts NREIP interns. Deadline: November 30, 2026.

item.title: NAWC Weapons Division student programs
item.description: Navy weapons test and research center with student hiring programs and NREIP positions. Timing: Pathways jobs are posted on USAJOBS; STEM student employment takes resumes through a NAVAIR form.

item.title: NDSEG Fellowship
item.description: National Defense Science and Engineering Graduate (NDSEG) Fellowship: three years of support for doctoral study in science and engineering aligned with defense research. Deadline: October 30, 2026.

item.title: NIWC Pacific student internships
item.description: San Diego Navy lab that hosts NREIP interns and hires STEM students through its Student Educational Employment Program and SDSU Research Foundation postings. Deadline: November 30, 2026.

item.title: NMSU PSL — Classified Ready Employee Workforce (CREW)
item.description: NMSU national-security career preparation combining practical experience, seminars and possible Secret-clearance sponsorship. NMSU reported DoD Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office support in 2025. Timing: September–April; in-person evening seminars every other week, plus about two hours of weekly preparation. Recruitment: late summer/early fall; no fixed deadline posted. Use the official interest form or crew@psl.nmsu.edu..

item.title: Nevada National Security Site student program
item.description: Twelve week paid summer internships, in person or hybrid; about 60 percent of 2025 interns kept working part time during the school year. Timing: The 2026 call closed January 30, 2026; watch for the 2027 call in December.

item.title: Northrop Grumman summer internships
item.description: Summer internships across Northrop Grumman sites in engineering, cyber, business and more. Timing: Summer roles post in the fall on the careers site.

item.title: Naval Postgraduate School internships (NREIP host)
item.description: Summer research with NPS faculty through NREIP; NPS also runs community college internships with Hartnell College and Monterey Peninsula College. Deadline: November 30, 2026.

item.title: NRC Research Associateship Programs
item.description: Postdoctoral and senior research awards at federal laboratories; search the listings for defense laboratory hosts. Deadline: November 1, 2026.

item.title: Naval Research Enterprise Internship Program (NREIP)
item.description: Ten week paid summer research internship at Navy laboratories across the country. Deadline: November 30, 2026.

item.title: NSWC Corona Division (NREIP host)
item.description: Navy warfare center for systems assessment, measurement science and range engineering; takes NREIP interns in computer science, electrical engineering, physics and systems engineering. Deadline: November 30, 2026.

item.title: ONR Summer Faculty Research Program
item.description: Ten-week paid summer research at Navy laboratories, with junior, senior and distinguished faculty appointments. Student participation: the faculty fellowship does not promise accompanying student places; ask the host about separately selected NREIP internships and a shared project. Timing: No upcoming application dates posted on the operator site as of September 30, 2026; check with the program and host laboratory..

item.title: ONR Young Investigator Program (FY2027)
item.description: Early career award for faculty doing Navy relevant research. Deadline: October 30, 2026.

item.title: DEVCOM Armaments Center student programs (Picatinny Arsenal)
item.description: The Army's armaments research center in New Jersey lists its student pathways: the SMART scholarship, the paid DoD College Acquisition Internship, AEOP apprenticeships and the HBCU/MI summer internships. Timing: The Armaments Center says HBCU/MI internship applications open each year from October to January.

item.title: RTX Raytheon internships in Tucson
item.description: Summer engineering internships at Raytheon's missile systems headquarters near the University of Arizona. Timing: Summer 2027 roles are posting now on the RTX careers site.

item.title: Sandia National Laboratories internships
item.description: Paid internships in engineering, science and computing at the national security lab in Albuquerque and Livermore. Timing: Postings on sandia.jobs; many summer roles post in the fall.

item.title: SMART Scholarship for Service
item.description: Full scholarship plus paid summer internships, followed by guaranteed civilian employment at a DoW facility. Deadline: December 4, 2026.

item.title: SMART application webinars and tips
item.description: Recorded sessions and tips for preparing a SMART application. Timing: Recorded; watch any time.

item.title: Southwest Research Institute summer internships
item.description: Summer internships on real projects at one of the largest independent research labs, much of it defense and space work. Timing: Recruiting through campus visits and the SwRI careers site; check for summer 2027 postings.

item.title: UCF Intelligence Community Center for Academic Excellence awards
item.description: Study abroad scholarships, internship support awards, student research awards and travel stipends for UCF students preparing for national security careers. Timing: See each award page for its cycle.

item.title: Army Institute of Surgical Research summer research
item.description: Undergraduate STEM research with combat casualty care research teams, including journal clubs, seminars and a poster presentation. Timing: Apply through the Alamo Colleges LSAMP program or the DoD HBCU/MI Science Program named on the USAISR page.

item.title: Test Resource Management Center (TRMC) internships at DoW test ranges
item.description: Paid 10 week summer internships at DoW test ranges across the country, with housing and travel covered for eligible interns. Past White Sands interns included UTEP and NMSU students. Deadline: November 30, 2026.
